Package com.sca4d.core.api.flow

Class FlowEngine

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.api.flow.FlowEngine
public final class FlowEngine extends Object
创建、推进和单次消费 FlowInstance。

根据 FlowEvent 选择唯一转换，并通过 FlowStore 乐观更新实例。
